title: 第728章 招待贵客第727章 优惠条件
slug: 开局亿年修为弹指间秒杀一切
content_zh:
“证明？”
“额，这要怎么证明？”
“难不成，我们去天灵阁总部，将他叫来？”
谢晚棠开口。
除了这种方法。
她想不出第二种，能证明她们与金不焕是朋友的方式。
“那倒不用。”
“我们少阁主，现在就在这里。”
“我可以直接带你们，去见他。”
“不过，少阁主此刻正在接待贵客。”
“所以。”
“我再问一遍。”
“你们确定，你们跟我们少阁主，是朋友？”
“要是你们撒谎，后果是会很严重的。”
随着丁长老的话落下。
唐蝶衣三女，顿时露出一脸惊讶的表情。
“你说，你们少阁主就在这里？”
“是的，我们少阁主，就在顶层接待贵客。”
“还真是走运，竟然能在这里碰到他。”
“既然如此。”

“丁长老，麻烦你带我们去见你们少阁主吧。”
“到时候，你就知道我们有没有撒谎骗你了。”
唐蝶衣开口道。
闻言。
虽然心中仍存有质疑，但丁长老并没有拒绝。
“好。”
“三位姑娘，这边请。”
“我带你们去顶层。”
说罢。
丁长老起身，上前带路。
唐蝶衣三女见状，没有过多犹豫，立即跟上。
片刻后。
在丁长老的带领下，一行四人顺利来到阁楼最顶层。
紧接着。
他们来到一间贵宾室前。
门口左右，站着两名散发着强大气息波动的护卫。
“你们来这里，所为何事？”
一名护卫拦下丁长老四人，并沉声询问道。
content_en:
"Proof?"
"Um, how do you prove this?"
"Is it possible that we go to the Tianling Pavilion headquarters and call him here?"
Xie Wantang spoke.
Except this method.
She couldn't think of a second way to prove that they were friends with Jin Buhuan.
"That's not necessary."
"Our young master is here now."
"I can take you directly to see him."
"However, the Young Pavilion Master is currently receiving distinguished guests."
"So."
"I'll ask again."
"Are you sure that you and our Young Pavilion Master are friends?"
"If you lie, the consequences will be serious."
Following Elder Ding's words.
The three girls in Tang Dieyi suddenly showed surprised expressions.
"You said, your young pavilion master is here?"
"Yes, our young master will receive distinguished guests on the top floor."
"I'm really lucky to meet him here."
"In that case."
"Elder Ding, please take us to see your young pavilion master."
"At that time, you will know whether we lied to you or not."
Tang Dieyi said.
Hear the words.
Although there were still doubts in his heart, Elder Ding did not refuse.
"Okay."
"Three girls, please come this way."
"I'll take you to the top."
Say it.
Elder Ding stood up and stepped forward to lead the way.
Upon seeing this, the three girls in Tang Dieyi followed immediately without much hesitation.
After a while.
Under the leadership of Elder Ding, a group of four people successfully reached the top floor of the attic.
Immediately afterwards.
They came to a VIP room.
To the left and right of the door, stood two guards exuding powerful aura fluctuations.
"Why are you here?"
A guard stopped the four elders Ding and asked in a deep voice.
